given: The public POST /webhooks/recall route is exempt from the auth wall but must prove the caller.
when: An attacker POSTs a crafted meeting-end webhook with a missing/mismatched x-recall-signature.
then: verify_recall_signature constant-time-compares the raw body against the secret and rejects 401 BEFORE any webhook_events row lands; a valid signature proceeds to the durable insert-then-200-then-idempotent-drain intake, so no forged event can trigger a close or roster change.
